name: quantumgridos-qec-evidence
description: Read-only review of quantum error-correction code, syndrome, decoder, and claim evidence

interface.shortDescription: Audit QEC records without hardware control
interface.longDescription: Inspect local code specifications, syndrome batches, distance runs, evidence claims, and bundle manifests through a read-only MCP server, then review circuit semantics, repetition boundaries, and the highest supported claim with a focused Skill.
defaultPrompt: Inspect this quantum error-correction code specification and identify algebraic gaps.
Review these distance runs and state the strongest supported scaling claim.
Audit this QEC evidence bundle without submitting or changing hardware jobs.
